answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 44093 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: masail of hair Question: Can I shave my mustache with blade or razor? Is it permissible or makrooh tahrimi? Answer ID: 44093 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 376/376/M=1434) Regarding shaving the moustache with blade or razor both types of sayings i.e. bida’h and sunnah are available. حلق الشارب بدعة وقيل سنة (در مختار) It is better and mustahab to trim it closely with scissors instead of shaving: والقص منه حتى يوازى الحرف الأعلى من الشفة العليا سنة بالإجماع (شامى) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
